# Slipway minimal

> The smallest site that uses every Slipway layout.

The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://github.com/docs/): Start here.
- [Layouts](https://github.com/docs/layouts/): The layouts Slipway ships.
- [Tokens](https://github.com/docs/tokens/): The design tokens.

## Pages

- [About](https://github.com/about.html): A plain page with a title and text.
- [بایگانی](https://github.com/fa/archive/): همهٔ نوشته‌ها، سال‌به‌سال.
- [Archive](https://github.com/archive/): Every post, year by year.
- [Build on Slipway](https://github.com/home.html): An editorial, RTL-ready site template, verified before it ships.
- [سلام اسلیپ‌وی](https://github.com/fa/): نمونهٔ راست‌به‌چپ با چیدمان پیش‌فرض اسلیپ‌وی.
- [Hallo Slipway](https://github.com/de/): Die deutsche Startseite.
- [Hello Slipway](https://github.com/): The smallest site that uses the Slipway layout.
- [Translation Status](https://github.com/status/): A translation status page.
- [Tags](https://github.com/tags/): Every tag and category, with its posts.
- [برچسب‌ها](https://github.com/fa/tags/): همهٔ برچسب‌ها و دسته‌ها با نوشته‌هایشان.
